props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: classes
props.description: Family slot class defaults for this instance.

props.name: items
props.description:
Keys displayed in order as one simultaneous shortcut. Each item is a key string, resolved
like `Kbd` `value`, or a `Kbd` props object to customize one key. The group renders nothing when empty.
examples:
import { KbdGroup } from 'moraine'

<KbdGroup items={['meta', { value: 'K', 'aria-label': 'letter K' }]} />

props.name: separator
props.description:
Text between keys, or a component rendered between each pair of keys. The component receives the
`index` of the key it follows.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: styles
props.description: Family slot style defaults for this instance.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual style variant applied to rendered shortcut keys.
